prompt: A creative vertical poster titled "GOOD MORNING GUANGZHOU" (广州早安) in the top left corner. The date "2026-10-09" and weather information are below the title. A quote reads: "热气腾腾，就是生活最好的回答" (Steaming hot is life's best answer). Another poetic line on the left says: "平凡食材也能长出城市的温柔" (Ordinary ingredients can also grow into the city's tenderness). The main visual features a surreal landscape made of giant, steaming rice noodle rolls (cheung fun) arranged like terraced fields or rolling hills. Tiny workers dressed as chefs and farmers are tending to these noodle fields—some sweeping, others pushing carts filled with green vegetables (scallions/peppers), and some harvesting. The noodles are translucent white, garnished with chopped scallions and orange bits (possibly carrot or shrimp roe). In the background, there is a hazy city skyline featuring the Canton Tower and skyscrapers under a bright sky. On the right side, a wooden signpost reads "广式肠粉" (Cantonese-style Cheung Fun) with smaller text "一份温柔 蒸向更好的日常" (A portion of gentleness, steamed towards a better daily routine). Bottom right text: "早茶让生活更有滋味" (Morning tea makes life more flavorful). The overall style is hyper-realistic miniature photography mixed with food art, bright, warm, and appetizing.

promptZh: 这是一张创意竖版海报，左上角标题为“GOOD MORNING GUANGZHOU”（广州早安）。标题下方显示日期“2026-10-09”及天气信息。海报中有一句引言：“热气腾腾，就是生活最好的回答”。左侧还有一行诗意文字：“平凡食材也能长出城市的温柔”。主视觉呈现了一个由巨大、冒着热气的肠粉构成的超现实景观，它们排列得像梯田或起伏的山丘。身穿厨师服和农民装束的微小工人正在照料这些“肠粉田”——有的在清扫，有的推着装满绿色蔬菜（葱/辣椒）的手推车，还有的在收割。肠粉呈半透明白色，点缀着切碎的葱花和橙色颗粒（可能是胡萝卜或虾籽）。背景是朦胧的城市天际线，包括广州塔和摩天大楼，天空明亮。右侧有一个木制路标，写着“广式肠粉”，下方小字为“一份温柔 蒸向更好的日常”。右下角文字为：“早茶让生活更有滋味”。整体风格为超写实微缩摄影与美食艺术的结合，画面明亮、温暖且令人食欲大开。
